question_set.question: Use trace_node with node_name equal to Dry Waste Bin to rank treatments by overall utilization efficiency in order to know how do treatments rank by overall utilization efficiency?

answer.value: Dry Waste Bin demonstrates highest recycling efficiency with 100% of its waste (5600 tons/day) being processed through recycling methods (Manual Sorting, Magnetic Sorting, and Optical Sorting), making it the most efficiently managed waste stream

key_insights: Dry Waste Bin achieves 100% recycling efficiency
Recyclable Bin also achieves 100% recycling efficiency
Other sources like Residential only achieve 16.92% recycling efficiency

reasoning_trace.rationale: Use trace_node to trace Dry Waste Bin node and analyze how its waste flows through recycling processes compared to other waste sources
